text: The factory's first issues and pull requests live in gitdek/invariant, and each issue becomes a project under `examples/`. GitHub Free offers no required checks or auto-merge on a private repository. So the factory merges its own pull request, but only once `invariant/gate` passes on its exact head commit. When the repository goes public, it switches to GitHub's native auto-merge with `invariant/gate` required. Amends how D-0004 merges.
